<article title="Billing, charges, and invoices">
When you place an order we authorize the full amount, and the charge settles when the order ships. A pending authorization and a settled charge can both appear for a day or two, which looks like a double charge; the pending one drops off automatically within five business days.

Receipts are emailed when the order ships, and you can download an invoice for any order from the Orders page.

If a charge appears that does not match an order in your account, contact us with the amount and date and we will investigate. Real duplicate charges are refunded within five business days.

</article>

Customer first name: Helen
<request>
wrong amount on my billing statement
my statement shows a charge of 240 but the order confirmation said 210. why was i charged more?
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Helen,

Thanks for reaching out. The article we have doesn't explain why a charge would differ from an order confirmation amount, so I can't tell you the reason from here. A support specialist will review your order and the 240 charge and follow up with you.

In the meantime, one thing that may help: when an order is placed we authorize the full amount, and the final charge settles when the order ships. A pending authorization and a settled charge can both show briefly, and the pending one drops off within five business days. You can also download an invoice for the order from the Orders page.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
